Standard: The temporary and test configurations are documented, approved, and managed to preclude any unauthorized changes. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Configuration documentation defines the authorized physical configuration of the air system with the temporary modifications completed. It consists of applicable technical data necessary to define the configuration and the design features of the air system shown to comply with the AW criteria applicable to the air system. Applicable technical data includes models, engineering design data, associated lists, and software documentation.
